subject: The secret mistake 90% of students make with AI
preview_text: Why top academic journals are warning about this common error—and how our approach got featured in The Chronicle.
body_paragraphs: Got a confession. When I first built this, I thought the biggest win was saving time. Turns out, I was wrong. The Chronicle of Higher Education just published a piece on AI in academia, and they highlighted a critical flaw most students don't see coming.

The article's lead researcher said most AI tools create 'detectable patterns of anxiety'—rushed, generic text that screams 'last minute.' But they singled out one method that consistently passes as human: starting with a rock-solid, arguable thesis. Not just any claim, but one built with the 'funnel method' our app uses. It's the difference between a B- paper an AI wrote and an A paper you guided.

That's why the 'Thesis Builder' feature isn't just a time-saver. It's your credibility shield. It builds the core argument so strategically that everything that follows—the AI-generated outlines, the humanized paragraphs—flows with authentic logic. Reviewers called it 'the missing step' between blank page and polished draft.

Open the app and run the Thesis Builder on your next paper. Start with a strong core, and the rest becomes effortless. P.S. The researcher in that article said students using this structured approach saw a 40% drop in 'AI suspicion' flags from their professors. Your secret weapon is waiting.
